records.question: Martin has 18 goldfish. Each week 5 goldfish die. Martin purchases 3 new goldfish every week. How many goldfish will Martin have in 7 weeks?
records.response:
Martin loses 5 goldfish each week, so after 7 weeks, he will have lost 5 * 7 = 35 goldfish.
Martin purchases 3 new goldfish each week, so after 7 weeks, he will have bought 3 * 7 = 21 goldfish.
Martin originally had 18 goldfish, so after 7 weeks, he will have 18 - 35 + 21 = 4 goldfish.
#### 4

records.question: After being contracted to build 4000 bollards on each side of a road, a company was only able to install 3/4 of the total number of bollards required on all sides of the road. How many more bollards are they required to install on all sides of the remaining part of the road?
records.response:
3/4 of 4000 bollards = (3/4)*4000 = 3000 bollards installed on each side.
4000 bollards per side * 2 sides = 8000 total bollards required.
3000 bollards installed * 2 sides = 6000 bollards installed in total.
8000 total bollards - 6000 bollards installed = 2000 bollards remaining to be installed.
#### 2000

The company was required to install 4000*2=8000 bollards on all sides of the road.
They were only able to install 8000*3/4=6000 bollards.
Therefore, they are required to install 8000-6000=2000 bollards more on all sides of the remaining part of the road.
